statusDefinitions.PENDING_REVIEW: Visual review has not yet been completed.
statusDefinitions.READY_FOR_REVIEW: Correction is implemented and awaits visual/runtime re-check.
statusDefinitions.WONT_FIX: Reviewed and explicitly determined that no correction is required.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Correction/review cannot proceed because a required source, tool, or environment is unavailable.

rules: Never delete old entries. Append findings and change status.
Every concrete visual problem gets its own issue id.
Record createdAt, updatedAt, completedAt, assetKey, category, observation, requiredFix, evidence, verification.
A fix is not DONE until visual and runtime re-checks are recorded.
If an item becomes unnecessary, set WONT_FIX and record the reason.
New chats must read this file before modifying Luna Say Maybe character assets.

issues.observation: sn_r_rebound never becomes the active live runtime frame in measures 1-4. SN:R hits at 4.930410s, but the next SN:L event starts at 5.038324s, only 0.107914s later. The current motion timing keeps hit active until +0.18s, so the next event replaces SN:R before its rebound phase can begin.
issues.requiredFix: Make phase timing event-gap-aware so short inter-note gaps still allocate a visible rebound interval without inserting neutral between rapid notes. For example, compress hit/rebound timing to fit before the next onset while preserving the no-neutral rapid-repeat rule. Re-run GitHub Pages QA and confirm sn_r_hit -> sn_r_rebound -> next SN:L hit on both PC and Xperia viewports.

issues.observation: On the live GitHub Pages 11-lane screen, SN:R hit -> sn_r_rebound produces a large discontinuity: the character changes from a left-facing/forward-leaning snare-hit pose to a substantially more rear/right-facing pose, with a major head/torso/hair silhouette change and noticeable seat/body registration shift. The change reads as a different drawing/camera orientation rather than a rebound from the preceding hit.
issues.requiredFix: Redraw or replace sn_r_rebound so it is derived closely from sn_r_hit: preserve the same camera orientation, head/body scale, stool registration and seated base; only move the right arm/stick and the minimum necessary shoulder/torso motion for rebound. Then redeploy and verify hit -> rebound -> next SN:L hit in the live 11-lane screen on PC and Xperia portrait.
